lines.text: Many learners say: I wish I can speak English well.
Better: I wish I could speak English well.
Could! I wish I could fly.

data.wrong: I wish I can speak English well.
data.right: I wish I could speak English well.

native.tip: نقول «ليتني أستطيع»، أما بعد wish فنستخدم could: “I wish I could speak English well.” وليس “I wish I can speak English well.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I wish I can speak English well.” 😅 نقول «ليتني أستطيع»، أما بعد wish فنستخدم could، فالجملة الصحيحة “I wish I could speak English well.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “I wish I can”?
en.tip: In Arabic we say «ليتني أستطيع», but in English we use could after wish: “I wish I could speak English well.” not “I wish I can speak English well.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I wish I can speak English well.” 😅 In Arabic we say «ليتني أستطيع», but in English we use could after wish, so the right sentence is “I wish I could speak English well.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
